title: Launch an AI account and land the first job
description: One real thing, built piece by piece. Every practice fills a slot, and what you end up with is an account you can send to a client — not a certificate.
outcome: A working profile, a body of posted work, a price list you are not afraid to send, and one proposal in front of a real client.
estimate: about 3 weeks at 20 minutes a day

stages.title: The face of it
stages.intent: Before anything can be posted, someone has to be able to tell in three seconds what you do and for whom.

slots.title: A name and a one-line promise
slots.brief: One line, under 12 words, naming who you help and what changes for them. No adjectives like «creative» or «passionate».

slots.title: A simple mark you can reuse
slots.brief: One square mark, 1:1, readable at 48 pixels. Flat colours only — gradients fall apart at small sizes.

slots.title: A profile image that is not generic
slots.brief: One image, 1:1, that would not fit any other account. If it could belong to 100 other profiles, it does not count.

slots.title: A bio someone can act on
slots.brief: Three lines: what you do, who for, how to start. First line under 60 characters — the rest gets cut off.

stages.title: The first posts
stages.intent: An empty account reads as abandoned. Five pieces of real work is the point where a stranger takes you seriously.

slots.title: A post that introduces you
slots.brief: Around 120 words saying what you do and why you started. One specific detail nobody else could write.

slots.title: A carousel that explains one thing
slots.brief: Four to six frames, 4:5, each carrying one idea. Consistent colours across every frame.

slots.title: A before and after of real work
slots.brief: Two images side by side showing one thing you improved. Label what changed in under 10 words.

slots.title: A short video introducing you
slots.brief: Between 20 and 40 seconds, 9:16, with captions. No camera needed — screen and voice is enough.

slots.title: A pinned post that tells people what to ask for
slots.brief: Around 80 words listing exactly what you take on and one sentence on how to start. This is the post that converts.

stages.title: Content that sells
stages.intent: Posting is not selling. This stage is the work that makes someone ask what you charge.

slots.title: A banner for one seasonal offer
slots.brief: One image, 9:16, product recognisable, warm natural light, no text baked into the image.

slots.title: Three captions for the same offer
slots.brief: Three versions under 40 words each, in the same voice, opening three different ways.

slots.title: A case study of one piece of work
slots.brief: Around 200 words: what they wanted, what you did, what changed. One number in it, even a small one.

slots.title: A short video showing the process
slots.brief: Between 15 and 30 seconds, 9:16, first 3 seconds showing the finished result before the process.

slots.title: A calendar you will actually keep
slots.brief: Four weeks planned, 3 posts a week, each with a topic and a format. Nothing vaguer than a named topic.

stages.title: Packaging the work
stages.intent: Nobody buys an hourly rate. This stage turns what you do into three things with prices on them.

slots.title: A price list with three options
slots.brief: Three packages with a number on each. The middle one is what most people should choose.

slots.title: A one-page description of what you sell
slots.brief: Under 300 words: what is included, what is not, how long it takes, what it costs.

slots.title: A proposal you can send in ten minutes
slots.brief: Under 250 words with blanks to fill. Opens with their problem, not with your background.

slots.title: An agreement in three lines
slots.brief: Three lines naming the deliverable, the number of revisions, and the payment terms.

stages.title: The first client
stages.intent: Everything above exists for this. The last stage is the one people skip, and skipping it is why nothing happens.

slots.title: A profile on one platform
slots.brief: One platform only, filled completely, with 3 samples from the work above attached.

slots.title: Fifteen messages actually sent
slots.brief: 15 messages to real prospects, each under 90 words and naming something specific about them.

slots.title: A script for the replies you get
slots.brief: Three short answers: for «how much», for «can you do X», and for silence after 4 days.

slots.title: One proposal in front of a real client
slots.brief: One proposal sent, built from the template, with a price and a date on it. Sent, not drafted.
